from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

# ==========================================
# CONSTANTS SECTION
# ==========================================

# Sec 16(ia) - Standard deduction amounts
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal("50000")                  # Sec 16(ia)
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal("75000")                  # Sec 115BAC

# Sec 24(b) - Interest on self-occupied property deduction limit
HP_INTEREST_LIMIT_OLD = Decimal("200000")             # Sec 24(b)

# Sec 80C - Aggregate deduction limit
SEC_80C_LIMIT = Decimal("150000")                     # Sec 80C read with 80CCE

# Sec 80CCD(1B) - Additional NPS contribution limit
SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT = Decimal("50000")                 # Sec 80CCD(1B)

# Sec 80D - Health insurance limits
SEC_80D_SELF_DEFAULT = Decimal("25000")               # Sec 80D(i)
SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")                # Sec 80D(i) senior citizen
SEC_80D_PARENT_DEFAULT = Decimal("25000")             # Sec 80D(ii)
SEC_80D_PARENT_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")              # Sec 80D(ii) senior citizen

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A - Old Regime Tax Slabs
OLD_SLABS_BELOW_60 = [
    (Decimal("250000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (None, Decimal("0.30"))
]
OLD_SLABS_SENIOR_60_80 = [
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (None, Decimal("0.30"))
]
OLD_SLABS_SUPER_80 = [
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (None, Decimal("0.30"))
]

# Sec 115BAC - New Tax Regime Slabs
NEW_SLABS = [
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("700000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("1500000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (None, Decimal("0.30"))
]

# Sec 87A - Rebate thresholds and maximums
REBATE_LIMIT_OLD = Decimal("500000")                  # Sec 87A (Old)
REBATE_MAX_OLD = Decimal("12500")                     # Sec 87A (Old)
REBATE_LIMIT_NEW = Decimal("700000")                  # Sec 87A (New)
REBATE_MAX_NEW = Decimal("25000")                     # Sec 87A (New)

# Surcharge thresholds and rates (Old & New)
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS = [
    (Decimal("5000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("10000000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("20000000"), Decimal("0.25")),
    (Decimal("50000000"), Decimal("0.37"))              # 37% capped at 25% for New Regime
]

# Health and Education Cess rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal("0.04")                           # Health and Education Cess


def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """
    Sec 288A / Sec 288B rounding:
    First drop paise (floor to whole rupees), then round to the nearest multiple of 10
    where a last digit of 5 or more rounds UP.
    """
    whole = amount.to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    remainder = whole % Decimal("10")
    if remainder >= Decimal("5"):
        return whole + (Decimal("10") - remainder)
    else:
        return whole - remainder


def calculate_hra_exempt(hra_received: Decimal, rent_paid: Decimal, basic_plus_da: Decimal, rent_city_is_metro: bool) -> Decimal:
    """Sec 10(13A) read with Rule 2A"""
    if rent_paid <= Decimal("0") or basic_plus_da <= Decimal("0"):
        return Decimal("0")
    
    # (a) HRA actually received
    a = hra_received
    
    # (b) rent actually paid in excess of 10% of salary
    b = rent_paid - (basic_plus_da * Decimal("0.10"))
    if b < Decimal("0"):
        b = Decimal("0")
        
    # (c) 50% of salary where metro, 40% elsewhere
    percentage = Decimal("0.50") if rent_city_is_metro else Decimal("0.40")
    c = basic_plus_da * percentage
    
    exempt = min(a, b, c)
    return max(exempt, Decimal("0"))


def compute_slab_tax(taxable_income: Decimal, slabs: list[tuple[Decimal | None, Decimal]]) -> tuple[Decimal, list[tuple[str, Decimal]]]:
    """Compute tax across slabs, returning total tax and breakdown per band."""
    tax = Decimal("0")
    breakdown = []
    prev_limit = Decimal("0")
    
    for limit, rate in slabs:
        if taxable_income <= prev_limit:
            break
        
        if limit is None or taxable_income <= limit:
            taxable_in_slab = taxable_income - prev_limit
        else:
            taxable_in_slab = limit - prev_limit
            
        slab_tax = taxable_in_slab * rate
        tax += slab_tax
        
        if limit is None:
            desc = f"Income above {prev_limit:,} at {rate*100}%"
        else:
            desc = f"Income between {prev_limit:,} and {limit:,} at {rate*100}%"
            
        breakdown.append((desc, slab_tax))
        
        if limit is None or taxable_income <= limit:
            break
        prev_limit = limit
        
    return tax, breakdown


def compute_surcharge_and_marginal_relief(tax_before_surcharge: Decimal, total_income: Decimal, is_new_regime: bool) -> tuple[Decimal, Decimal, Decimal]:
    """Compute surcharge and marginal relief."""
    applicable_threshold = None
    applicable_rate = Decimal("0")
    
    # Determine applicable surcharge rate and threshold
    for threshold, rate in SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS:
        if total_income > threshold:
            r = Decimal("0.25") if (is_new_regime and rate > Decimal("0.25")) else rate
            applicable_threshold = threshold
            applicable_rate = r
            
    if applicable_threshold is None or applicable_rate == Decimal("0"):
        return Decimal("0"), Decimal("0"), Decimal("0")
        
    raw_surcharge = tax_before_surcharge * applicable_rate
    
    # Marginal Relief Calculation
    # Tax + Surcharge at total income vs Tax + Surcharge at threshold + excess income over threshold
    # Note: tax at threshold needs to use the same slab rules and tax calculation function.
    # We will pass a helper or compute it.
    return raw_surcharge, applicable_threshold, applicable_rate


def run_regime(inp: dict, is_new_regime: bool) -> dict:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp["gross_salary"]))
    age = inp["age"]
    hra_received = Decimal(str(inp["hra_received"]))
    basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp["basic_plus_da"]))
    rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp["rent_paid"]))
    rent_city_is_metro = inp["rent_city_is_metro"]
    home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp["home_loan_interest"]))
    sec_80c = Decimal(str(inp["sec_80c"]))
    sec_80ccd_1b = Decimal(str(inp["sec_80ccd_1b"]))
    health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_self"]))
    health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_parents"]))
    parents_senior = inp["parents_senior"]
    
    trace = []
    
    # 1. Salary Income & Deductions
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })
    
    current_salary = gross_salary
    
    if not is_new_regime:
        # HRA Exemption
        hra_exempt = calculate_hra_exempt(hra_received, rent_paid, basic_plus_da, rent_city_is_metro)
        if hra_exempt > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "HRA exemption",
                "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
                "clause": "Sec 10(13A)"
            })
            current_salary -= hra_exempt
            
        # Standard Deduction (Old)
        std_ded_amt = min(STD_DEDUCTION_OLD, current_salary)
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Standard deduction",
            "amount": str(-std_ded_amt),
            "clause": "Sec 16(ia)"
        })
        current_salary -= std_ded_amt
    else:
        # Standard Deduction (New)
        std_ded_amt = min(STD_DEDUCTION_NEW, current_salary)
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Standard deduction",
            "amount": str(-std_ded_amt),
            "clause": "Sec 16(ia) read with Sec 115BAC"
        })
        current_salary -= std_ded_amt
        
    salary_income = max(current_salary, Decimal("0"))
    
    # House Property Income / Loss (Old regime only)
    hp_loss = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime:
        allowed_hp_interest = min(home_loan_interest, HP_INTEREST_LIMIT_OLD)
        if allowed_hp_interest > 0:
            hp_loss = allowed_hp_interest
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Loss from self-occupied house property set off",
                "amount": str(-hp_loss),
                "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)"
            })
            
    gti = salary_income - hp_loss
    if gti < Decimal("0"):
        gti = Decimal("0")
        
    # Chapter VI-A Deductions (Old regime only)
    total_via = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime:
        # Sec 80C capped at SEC_80C_LIMIT
        ded_80c = min(sec_80c, SEC_80C_LIMIT)
        if ded_80c > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80C",
                "amount": str(-ded_80c),
                "clause": "Sec 80C"
            })
            total_via += ded_80c
            
        # Sec 80CCD(1B) capped at SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT
        ded_80ccd = min(sec_80ccd_1b, SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT)
        if ded_80ccd > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80CCD(1B)",
                "amount": str(-ded_80ccd),
                "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"
            })
            total_via += ded_80ccd
            
        # Sec 80D
        limit_self = SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR if (age >= 60) else SEC_80D_SELF_DEFAULT
        ded_self = min(health_ins_self, limit_self)
        limit_parent = SEC_80D_PARENT_SENIOR if parents_senior else SEC_80D_PARENT_DEFAULT
        ded_parent = min(health_ins_parents, limit_parent)
        ded_80d = ded_self + ded_parent
        if ded_80d > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80D for health insurance",
                "amount": str(-ded_80d),
                "clause": "Sec 80D"
            })
            total_via += ded_80d
            
        # Sec 80A(2) overall cap on Chapter VI-A deductions (cannot exceed GTI)
        if total_via > gti:
            excess = total_via - gti
            # Adjust trace or just cap total_via
            total_via = gti
            
    # Total Income before rounding
    unrounded_total_income = gti - total_via
    if unrounded_total_income < Decimal("0"):
        unrounded_total_income = Decimal("0")
        
    # Sec 288A Rounding of total income
    total_income = round_nearest_ten(unrounded_total_income)
    
    # Sec 288A trace line (adjustment amount)
    sec_288a_diff = total_income - unrounded_total_income
    if sec_288a_diff != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Rounding off total income",
            "amount": str(sec_288a_diff),
            "clause": "Sec 288A"
        })
        
    # Tax Calculation
    if is_new_regime:
        slabs = NEW_SLABS
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_SUPER_80
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_SENIOR_60_80
        else:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_BELOW_60
            
    tax_before_rebate, slab_breakdown = compute_slab_tax(total_income, slabs)
    
    for desc, slab_tax_amt in slab_breakdown:
        if slab_tax_amt > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": f"Income-tax: {desc}",
                "amount": str(slab_tax_amt),
                "clause": "First Schedule, Part III, Para A" if not is_new_regime else "Sec 115BAC"
            })
            
    # Sec 87A Rebate
    rebate = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime:
        if total_income <= REBATE_LIMIT_OLD:
            rebate = min(tax_before_rebate, REBATE_MAX_OLD)
    else:
        if total_income <= REBATE_LIMIT_NEW:
            rebate = min(tax_before_rebate, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
        else:
            # Marginal relief for new regime Sec 87A
            # where total income exceeds 7,00,000 and tax payable exceeds (total income - 7,00,000)
            excess_income = total_income - REBATE_LIMIT_NEW
            if tax_before_rebate > excess_income:
                rebate = tax_before_rebate - excess_income
                
    if rebate > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rebate under Section 87A",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A"
        })
        
    tax_after_rebate = max(tax_before_rebate - rebate, Decimal("0"))
    
    # Surcharge & Surcharge Marginal Relief
    surcharge = Decimal("0")
    surcharge_marginal_relief = Decimal("0")
    
    applicable_threshold = None
    applicable_rate = Decimal("0")
    for threshold, rate in SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS:
        if total_income > threshold:
            r = Decimal("0.25") if (is_new_regime and rate > Decimal("0.25")) else rate
            applicable_threshold = threshold
            applicable_rate = r
            
    if applicable_threshold is not None and applicable_rate > Decimal("0"):
        raw_surcharge = tax_after_rebate * applicable_rate
        
        # Calculate tax + surcharge at threshold for marginal relief
        # Tax at threshold
        tax_at_threshold, _ = compute_slab_tax(applicable_threshold, slabs)
        # Rebate at threshold (if any, though threshold > rebate limit usually, but good practice)
        rebate_at_threshold = Decimal("0")
        if not is_new_regime:
            if applicable_threshold <= REBATE_LIMIT_OLD:
                rebate_at_threshold = min(tax_at_threshold, REBATE_MAX_OLD)
        else:
            if applicable_threshold <= REBATE_LIMIT_NEW:
                rebate_at_threshold = min(tax_at_threshold, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
        tax_after_rebate_at_threshold = max(tax_at_threshold - rebate_at_threshold, Decimal("0"))
        
        # Surcharge at threshold
        surcharge_at_threshold = Decimal("0")
        for t2, r2 in SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS:
            if applicable_threshold > t2:
                r_t2 = Decimal("0.25") if (is_new_regime and r2 > Decimal("0.25")) else r2
                surcharge_at_threshold = tax_after_rebate_at_threshold * r_t2
                
        total_tax_plus_surcharge_threshold = tax_after_rebate_at_threshold + surcharge_at_threshold
        income_excess = total_income - applicable_threshold
        max_allowed_total = total_tax_plus_surcharge_threshold + income_excess
        
        current_total_tax_surcharge = tax_after_rebate + raw_surcharge
        if current_total_tax_surcharge > max_allowed_total:
            surcharge_marginal_relief = current_total_tax_surcharge - max_allowed_total
            surcharge = raw_surcharge - surcharge_marginal_relief
        else:
            surcharge = raw_surcharge
            
    if surcharge > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": f"Surcharge at applicable rate",
            "amount": str(raw_surcharge),
            "clause": "First Schedule"
        })
        
    if surcharge_marginal_relief > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Marginal relief on surcharge",
            "amount": str(-surcharge_marginal_relief),
            "clause": "First Schedule / Surcharge provisions"
        })
        
    tax_after_surcharge = tax_after_rebate + surcharge
    
    # Health and Education Cess (4%)
    cess = tax_after_surcharge * CESS_RATE
    if cess > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and Education Cess @ 4%",
            "amount": str(cess),
            "clause": "Finance Act"
        })
        
    unrounded_tax_payable = tax_after_surcharge + cess
    
    # Sec 288B Rounding of tax
    tax_payable = round_nearest_ten(unrounded_tax_payable)
    
    sec_288b_diff = tax_payable - unrounded_tax_payable
    if sec_288b_diff != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rounding off tax",
            "amount": str(sec_288b_diff),
            "clause": "Sec 288B"
        })
        
    return {
        "total_income": int(total_income),
        "tax_payable": int(tax_payable),
        "trace": trace
    }


def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    old_result = run_regime(inp, is_new_regime=False)
    new_result = run_regime(inp, is_new_regime=True)
    return {
        "old": old_result,
        "new": new_result
    }
